programmes.d: RWBY is reunited and now they must begin the perilous job of escorting the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas.
Team RWBY are brought the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas, but the futuristic city looks can be deceiving.
Team RWBY's worst fears have materialized. Salem has arrived, and the timing couldn't be worse.
RWBY have been thrust into an unknown world known as the Ever After! But appearances are deceptive.

2029 – A female government cyber agent and the Internal Bureau of Investigations are hot on the trail of a "The Puppet Master" – a computer virus capable of invading cybernetic brains and altering its victim’s memory.
A secret police force known as the Black Guard protects the boundary between the human world and the demon world.
After dying and entering Hell, a teenager, Amagane, makes unexpected friends with the demons in her new class in this anime tale.
